# Can you actually ship these dependencies?

> Paste your dependency licenses, say how you ship (closed-source app, SaaS, internal tool, or an open-source license) and see which dependencies conflict — GPL in a proprietary app, Apache-2.0 in GPL-2.0-only, AGPL and SSPL in a service. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
